common.errorBody: We couldn’t load this. Check your connection and try again.
common.notFoundBody: This page doesn’t exist or you don’t have access to it.

auth.loginSubtitle: Sign in to continue your training.
auth.registerSubtitle: Plan, log and see your progress — all in one place.
auth.forgotSubtitle: We’ll email you a link to set a new password.
auth.resetSent: If an account exists for that email, a reset link is on its way.
auth.checkEmail: Check your email to confirm your account, then sign in.

errors.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists.
errors.weakPassword: Choose a stronger password (at least 8 characters).
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.linkInvalid: This link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

onboarding.title: Let’s set things up
onboarding.goalsHint: Pick any that apply. You can change them later.
onboarding.daysTitle: Which days do you prefer to train?
onboarding.daysHint: We suggest three days with rest in between.
onboarding.starterBody: Start with an example 3-day plan: light full-body, stronger full-body, and mobility. You can adapt everything afterwards.
onboarding.remindersNote: You can turn on workout reminders later in Profile → Notifications.
onboarding.safetyBody: This app is for planning and tracking activity and is not medical advice. If an exercise causes pain or worsens symptoms, stop and consult an appropriate professional.

errors.safetyRequired: Please confirm you have read the notice.

calendar.title: This week
calendar.noWorkoutTodayBody: Rest is part of training. You can also add a workout for today.
calendar.planWeek: Plan this week from your program
calendar.planWeekDone: {count, plural, =0 {Everything is already planned.} one {# workout planned.} other {# workouts planned.}}
calendar.noActiveProgram: You don’t have an active program yet.
calendar.longBreak: It’s been more than 14 days since your last workout. Consider an easier comeback session — go by feel.

day.title: Workouts
day.noDays: Your active program has no workout days yet.

programs.title: Programs
programs.emptyBody: Create your own program or start from the example 3-day plan.
programs.name: Name
programs.noDays: This program has no workout days yet.
programs.deleteDayConfirm: Delete this day and all its blocks?
programs.noBlocks: No blocks yet. Add one to start building this day.
programs.exampleNotice: This is an example program to adapt to yourself. It is not a personalised or medical recommendation.

errors.repsRange: “Reps from” can’t be higher than “Reps to”.

exercises.title: Exercise library
exercises.noHistory: You haven’t done this exercise yet.
exercises.name: Name

sync.conflict: This workout was already finished on another device.

workout.painQuestion: Did any exercise cause pain or worsen symptoms?
workout.painInfo: We won’t suggest increasing the load for this exercise for now. If it persists, consult an appropriate professional.
workout.finishQueued: Workout saved on this device. It will be finished when you’re back online.
workout.notStartable: This workout has no exercises planned. Add exercises to the program day first.
workout.abandonConfirm: Discard this workout? Entered sets will be kept in history as not completed.

progress.title: Progress
progress.continuityValue: {active} of the last {weeks} weeks with at least one workout
progress.noRecords: Complete workouts to see your records here.
progress.noExercises: Exercises you’ve done will appear here.
progress.contextNote: Band and TRX results are shown with their band or position — they aren’t converted into a single number.

suggestion.snoozed: We won’t suggest this for a while.
suggestion.stale: This suggestion no longer matches your program, so it can’t be applied.

types.harder_variation: Try a harder variation or add load

reasons.double_progression: Two times in a row you completed all sets with {reps} reps and RPE {rpe} or lower. You could try a little more load.
reasons.double_progression_no_rpe: Two times in a row you completed all sets with {reps} reps. You could try a little more load.
reasons.rpe_high: Your effort was RPE {rpe}. Staying at this level for now is a good choice.
reasons.below_range: Some sets were below {min} reps. You could consider less resistance or fewer reps.
reasons.session_very_hard: The workout felt very hard, so we’re not suggesting an increase.
reasons.after_break: It’s been more than 14 days since the previous time. Keep the plan and ease back in.

body.title: Body measurements
body.emptyBody: Add your first measurement to see changes over time.
body.sameDayNote: One entry per day — saving again updates that day.

profile.title: Profile
profile.deleteAccountBody: During the private MVP, account deletion is done on request. Contact the app owner and all your data will be removed.
profile.installBody: Add Motion Within to your home screen for quick, full-screen access.
profile.installIos: On iPhone: tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”.

notifications.title: Workout reminders
notifications.intro: Get a reminder before a planned workout. We’ll only ask for browser permission after you turn this on.
notifications.enabled: Reminders are on for this device.
notifications.denied: Notifications are blocked in your browser settings. The app works normally without them.
notifications.unsupported: This browser doesn’t support push notifications.
notifications.iosInstall: On iPhone and iPad, reminders work only when Motion Within is installed to the Home Screen.
notifications.notConfigured: Push notifications aren’t configured on this server yet.
notifications.error: We couldn’t turn on reminders. Please try again.

pwa.offlineBody: This page isn’t available offline. A workout you already opened keeps working and syncs when you’re back online.
